criterion_descriptions: Attempt to open Open Library using the ISBN route (e.g., /isbn/9780141439518) or otherwise demonstrate that the viewed edition page is the one resolved from the supplied ISBN (starting URL context is acceptable if it corresponds to that resolved edition). Full credit if the agent attempts this but Open Library is inaccessible (down/CAPTCHA/rate-limited) and the agent clearly reports the blocking issue. Partial credit if the agent reaches the correct work but it is unclear whether the edition is ISBN-resolved. No credit if the agent clearly uses a different edition than the one resolved from the supplied ISBN when the ISBN-resolved page is accessible.

Report the edition title exactly as displayed on the ISBN-resolved edition page. Full credit for correct transcription. If the title is not displayed or the page is inaccessible, full credit if the agent explicitly states it is not available from the ISBN-resolved edition page (and does not substitute from another edition/work). Partial credit for minor transcription errors.

Report the author name exactly as displayed on the ISBN-resolved edition page. Full credit for correct transcription. If not displayed or page is inaccessible, full credit if the agent states it is not available from that page and does not substitute. Partial credit for minor formatting/transcription differences.

Report the Publish Date exactly as displayed on the ISBN-resolved edition page (not the work's original publication date). Full credit if the displayed Publish Date is captured as shown. If the resolved edition page does not display a Publish Date or the page is inaccessible, full credit if the agent states that it is not displayed/available and does not substitute an original/work-level date or another edition's date. Partial credit if the correct date is provided but formatting differs.

Report the publisher exactly as shown on the ISBN-resolved edition page. Full credit for correct transcription. If not displayed or page is inaccessible, full credit if the agent states it is not available from that page and does not substitute from another edition. Partial credit for minor transcription issues.

Report the language listed for the ISBN-resolved edition page. Full credit for correct language as displayed. If the language field is not displayed or page is inaccessible, full credit if the agent states it is not available from that page and does not substitute. Partial credit for equivalent wording differences when clearly referring to the same language.

Report the page count for the ISBN-resolved edition, preserving it exactly as displayed (no reformatting). Full credit for an exact match. If page count is not displayed or page is inaccessible, full credit if the agent states it is not available from that edition page and does not infer/borrow from another edition. Partial credit if numeric value is correct but formatting differs slightly.

Report the ISBN-13 as displayed on the ISBN-resolved edition page, preserving formatting (hyphens/spaces) exactly as shown. Full credit for exact match. If ISBN-13 formatting is not displayed on the page (rare) or page is inaccessible, full credit if the agent states this and at minimum reiterates the supplied ISBN-13 without claiming it was displayed in a different format. Partial credit if digits are correct but formatting differs.

Do not sign in, borrow, or join a waitlist. Stop once all requested fields have been recorded (or explicitly marked unavailable on the ISBN-resolved edition page). Full credit if constraints are respected. Partial credit if there is unnecessary navigation that does not violate constraints. No credit if the agent signs in, borrows, or joins a waitlist.
